added_failures_note: unmeasured: the reviewed manifest declares no baseline_suite or after_suite, and reckon.crew.review.added_failures_from_gate_logs over its arm logs logs/base.log and logs/head.log returns (None, []) because neither is in a recognised gate-log format — both were cancelled mid-run before any summary line, so the count was not taken rather than taken as zero.

findings.text: blocking: the done_when's whole-suite guarded measurement was not taken. It demands the suite run under the guard in one exclusive all_debug job with a base and an after arm, each log naming its revision and ending in EXIT=, finding no test resolving the real cache and no added failure against base; instead the run recorded focused id subsets, logs/base.log and logs/head.log end mid-progress with no summary line and no EXIT=, and the two sbatch jobs (slurm-1287893.out, slurm-1287900.out) were CANCELLED, so the manifest declares neither baseline_suite nor after_suite and 'no added failure against base' is asserted without the measurement the done-when names.

follow-on: the fixture sets only XDG_CACHE_HOME and leaves RECKON_HOME as found, deviating from plan §9 and the node done-when, which name RECKON_HOME among the levers. reckon/_store.py:172 reads RECKON_HOME before the cache home for pick-input, the kind that names the ledger index in the original defect, so a session launched with RECKON_HOME pointing at the real home resolves that root into it; the guard records the leak but the redirect the plan asked for is absent.

follow-on: the pick-input/run-time-profile assertion accepts 'steered or _within(resolved, session_root)' where steered measures the resolution against the same RECKON_HOME the code under test reads, so that half is not independent of the value it checks; the check that actually carries the guard is the cache_root_leaks() failure below it, and the assertion would read true against a real-home RECKON_HOME were the leak record empty.

item_verdicts.call_sites: verified 2 production call site(s) of the wrapped reckon/_store.cache_root the guard instruments
item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit against d0d0d28c4; ab3da5d91 adds the session fixture and the cache_root wrapper, 98ca42916 asserts the guard from the session teardown, ca161be6e pins UV_CACHE_DIR and drops the per-kind overrides, 8f0f38f87 adds the evidence fragment, all additions with no deletions.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done_when asserts a whole-suite run under the guard in one exclusive all_debug job with base and after arms each ending EXIT=; the manifest records focused id subsets (14 and 7 ids) and logs/base.log and logs/head.log end mid-progress with no summary or EXIT=, so the gate ran does not assert that measure.
item_verdicts.goal: the node goal is to redirect every test's cache roots to a session temporary directory and guard that no test resolves the real cache; tests/conftest.py:1304 redirects XDG_CACHE_HOME to a session tmp tree and tests/conftest.py:92 wraps reckon/_store.cache_root to record every ambient resolution outside it, but RECKON_HOME is left as found so the kinds reading it first are covered only when it is unset.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it records commits ab3da5d91, 98ca42916, ca161be6e, 8f0f38f87, the revised XDG-only mechanism, the 14+7 focused ids passing, the positive control firing at EXIT=1, its disclosure that the declared fixture-removed negative control no longer fires at the revised head, and no baseline_suite or after_suite field.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the manifest declares tests/conftest.py, tests/test_no_test_resolves_the_real_cache.py and the evidence fragment; git diff d0d0d28c4..8f0f38f87 touches exactly those three paths and no other file.

justifications.durability: tests/test_no_test_resolves_the_real_cache.py:48 fails on a reinstated leak: with the session fixture removed the guard records client and pick-input resolutions and the test reddens, logs/focused-neg.log EXIT=1, and the armed control at logs/positive-control-n4.log EXIT=1 names velocity -> /home/ITER/mcintos/.cache/reckon/velocity, so the guard demonstrably fires.
justifications.evidence: the done_when demands the whole suite under the guard in one exclusive all_debug sbatch job with base and after arms ending in EXIT=; logs/base.log and logs/head.log end mid-progress with no summary line and no EXIT=, both slurm jobs were CANCELLED, and the manifest declares no baseline_suite or after_suite, so the recorded focused subsets never establish the no-added-failure measure the done_when asserts.
justifications.fit: tests/conftest.py:1304 follows the established session-scoped autouse idiom of tests/conftest.py:1368 isolated_claude_skills_dir, and the new names (session_cache_roots_are_isolated, cache_root_leaks, install_cache_root_guard, _run_cache_root_guard_last) carry no plan, ticket or version label.
justifications.goal_fidelity: tests/conftest.py:1304 session_cache_roots_are_isolated moves XDG_CACHE_HOME to a session tmp tree and tests/conftest.py:92 install_cache_root_guard wraps reckon/_store.cache_root, but the fixture leaves RECKON_HOME as found, so the two kinds reckon/_store.py:172,173 read before the cache home (pick-input, which names the ledger index) are redirected only while ambient RECKON_HOME is unset, unlike the plan §9 levers.
justifications.reuse: no owner for a session-wide cache-root isolation guard exists; the fixture is a new capability and the guard extends the resolved path of the owner reckon/_store.py:158 cache_root rather than forking it, so the addition wraps the single owner.
justifications.scope_discipline: git diff d0d0d28c4..8f0f38f87 touches exactly tests/conftest.py, tests/test_no_test_resolves_the_real_cache.py and docs/evidence/fragments/the-crew-home-has-a-bound/no-test-resolves-the-real-cache.html (299 insertions, 0 deletions), all inside the manifest's declared write paths.
